caseName: World Marine Insurance v. Lackawanna Transportation Co.
caseNameFull: World Marine Insurance Company (Limited) v. Lackawanna Transportation Company

opinions.text: May 31, 1904. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals, for the Second Circuit denied. Mr. Wilhelmus Mynderse for petitioners. Mr. Jno. G. Milburn and Mr. Harvey D. Goulder for respondents.
